circuit_breaker.note: Commandment IX: after 3 losing trades in a row, take a break

capital_preservation.note: Commandment I: have enough cash to survive the drawdown

trade_filters.note: Commandment V & VII: know when to trade and when to wait

scaling.note: Rule: go from 1-lot to 2-lot, not 1 to 10

loss_review.note: Commandment VIII: love your losers like your winners

ego_guard.note: Commandment X: control ego after big wins

bias_rules.description: Conditions that define directional bias — D1 must agree with H4 before executing on H1/M15
bias_rules.notes: D1 bias must align with H4 before entering on H1 or M15. Exception: ultra-high confidence (>85) setups with pattern + OB + sweep confluence.

dual_tf_confluence._comment: v2.2: HTF bias + LTF precision framework — backtest-hardened over 6mo XAUUSD data
dual_tf_confluence.description: Higher time frame (HTF) sets directional bias. Lower time frame (LTF) provides precise entry timing. Only trade when HTF bias aligns with LTF structure.

timeframe_hierarchy.HTF: H4 — directional bias, BOS/CHoCH, Order Block zones, major liquidity
timeframe_hierarchy.MTF: H1 — execution timeframe, entry timing, position size calculation
timeframe_hierarchy.LTF: M15 — precision entry, stop placement, micro-structure confirmation
timeframe_hierarchy.micro: M5 — optional for pinpoint entries during high-confluence setups

htf_bias_rules.neutral_bias_action: HALT — no directional trades until HTF resolves. Only scalp within range with reduced size.

ltf_precision_rules.long_entry: M15 bullish CHoCH + price retesting bullish OB/FVG + HTF bias bullish
ltf_precision_rules.short_entry: M15 bearish CHoCH + price retesting bearish OB/FVG + HTF bias bearish
ltf_precision_rules.invalid_ltf_signal: If LTF opposes HTF, mark CONFLICT. Do not enter. Wait for alignment or reassess HTF bias.
ltf_precision_rules.sl_placement: Below/above most recent M15 swing low/high + ATR buffer (1.2x)

execution_conditions: HTF direction MUST match LTF direction for full position
HTF direction vs LTF CONFLICT = no trade (wait for re-alignment)
HTF NEUTRAL + LTF clear = 50% reduced size scalp only
HTF clear + LTF NEUTRAL = wait for LTF clarity (choppy)
TP targets map to OPPOSING liquidity on HTF (next PDH/PDL, equal highs/lows)

quarter_theory._comment: ICT Quarter Theory divides ANY price range into 4 equal quarters
quarter_theory.description: Price ranges (daily, weekly, session) split into 4 quarters. Institutions buy in discount (Q1-Q2), sell in premium (Q3-Q4).

equilibrium.significance: Key reversal and decision point — price respects this often
equilibrium.notes: If price is at equilibrium, wait for a clear BOS or CHoCH before entering

ote_fibonacci.description: Optimal Trade Entry — most precise entry within a discount/premium
ote_fibonacci.buy_ote_zone: 62-79% retracement INTO the discount (21-38% of daily range from low)
ote_fibonacci.sell_ote_zone: 62-79% retracement INTO the premium (62-79% of daily range from low)
ote_fibonacci.notes: Entering at OTE gives tightest SL, best R:R, and highest probability fills

rules: Never buy in Q4 (premium) unless extreme reversal setup with 3+ confluence factors
Never sell in Q1 (deep discount) unless breakdown of major structure confirmed
Best long entries: Q1-Q2 with OB or FVG present + sweep confirmation
Best short entries: Q3-Q4 with bearish OB or FVG + sweep confirmation
At equilibrium (50%): wait for directional confirmation before entering

ob_precision_entry.description: Pinpoint entry rules for Order Block retests

ote_50_pct.description: 50% midpoint of OB body — standard precision entry

ote_62_pct.description: 62% Fibonacci of OB range — deep OTE

ote_79_pct.description: 79% Fibonacci of OB range — deepest OTE (tightest SL)

ob_open.description: OB candle open level — institutional reference price

rules: NEVER enter at OB extreme (high/low) — always enter at 50% or deeper
Use OTE 50% as default entry, OTE 79% for tightest stop when confident
If price tests OB but does not reach 50% level, DO NOT enter — wait
Confirm OB test with a displacement candle (strong close through OB midpoint)
OB is invalidated when price closes THROUGH it entirely — then look for next OB
Preferred: OB that originated from a liquidity sweep (strongest form)
confirmation_required: Rejection wick or engulfing candle within OB zone
RSI divergence at OB touch (lower high RSI on equal price high = bearish, vice versa)
Volume spike at OB touch confirms institutional activity

entry_rules.notes: 2 conditions = valid entry. 4+ conditions = scale full position. 6+ conditions = potential scale-in on winner.

technical_pattern_rules.description: Technical patterns add confluence but are NOT standalone signals — must align with ICT structure

double_top.notes: Strongest when second peak forms at a bearish OB or FVG in Q3-Q4

double_bottom.notes: Strongest when second bottom forms at a bullish OB or FVG in Q1-Q2

head_and_shoulders.notes: Right shoulder ideally forms at bearish OB — highest probability version

rising_wedge.notes: Rising wedge in uptrend = distribution. Sell break of lower trendline.

falling_wedge.notes: Falling wedge in downtrend = accumulation. Buy break of upper trendline.

rules: Pattern alone is NOT enough — always require ICT OB/FVG confluence
Pattern confirmed only when price closes through neckline/trendline on the break candle
Pattern retest (pullback to broken neckline) = highest probability entry
Pattern target is minimum — TP3 can target next major liquidity level

push_exhaustion_rules.description: Detects momentum phase: PUSH = continuation, EXHAUSTION = reversal imminent

push_phase.definition: 3+ consecutive candles same direction with increasing body sizes, wicks decreasing
push_phase.action: Trade with momentum — avoid counter-trend entries during push phase
push_phase.notes: During push phase in trend direction = add to position or enter fresh with tight trail

exhaustion_phase.definition: 3+ consecutive candles same direction but bodies shrinking and wicks growing
exhaustion_phase.action: Prepare for reversal — look for OB retest or FVG fill entry
exhaustion_phase.notes: Exhaustion at a premium OB (Q3-Q4) = highest probability SELL signal. At discount FVG (Q1-Q2) = highest probability BUY signal.

rules: PUSH + trend direction: raise TP targets, tighten trail stop, do not exit early
EXHAUSTION at OB/FVG: high-confidence reversal entry signal
Candles: body must be > 40% of total range to count in push (no doji)
Count resets when a candle closes opposite direction

support_resistance_rules.description: Key S/R levels and how to trade them

swing_high_low.notes: Single touch can be key if from a strong impulse

equal_highs_lows.notes: Two identical levels = liquidity pool, expect sweep

session_highs_lows.notes: Asia/London/NY session H/L = major intraday S/R

previous_week_hl.notes: PWH/PWL = major swing targets, take profit here

order_block_zones.notes: Active unmitigated OBs are the most precise S/R

TESTING_RESISTANCE.action: Wait for rejection candle or enter on confirmation
TESTING_RESISTANCE.aggressive: Sell limit at resistance if strong D1/H4 bias aligns

EXHAUSTING_AT_RESISTANCE.action: HIGH PROBABILITY SELL — enter on any bearish confirmation candle
EXHAUSTING_AT_RESISTANCE.notes: Exhaustion + resistance + Q3-Q4 = best short setup

PUSHING_INTO_RESISTANCE.action: Do NOT sell yet — momentum could break through. Wait for reversal candle first.
PUSHING_INTO_RESISTANCE.notes: False breakouts above resistance are common — they become liquidity sweeps

EXHAUSTING_AT_SUPPORT.action: HIGH PROBABILITY BUY — enter on any bullish confirmation candle
EXHAUSTING_AT_SUPPORT.notes: Exhaustion + support + Q1-Q2 = best long setup

PUSHING_THROUGH_SUPPORT.action: Do NOT buy. Wait for reclaim above support + confirmation.
PUSHING_THROUGH_SUPPORT.notes: Breakdown may continue to next S/R level — let it play out

accumulation.action: SWEEP_ENTRIES_ONLY — mark range, do not trade FVG/CHoCH
accumulation.notes: Asia/Accumulation: identify the range for London manipulation targets. Only genuine sweep-based reversals allowed (75+ confidence). FVG/CHoCH entries blocked — ICT requires the sweep to precede the imbalance entry.

manipulation.notes: London open (07-09 UTC) is highest priority. Expect liquidity sweep of Asia high or low. Enter on OB retest after sweep confirms direction.

distribution.notes: NY open (12-14 UTC) confirms direction set by London. Scale into winning trades if push momentum confirmed.

session_rules.description: All sessions are now tradeable — session-specific rules apply

ASIA.notes: Lower liquidity — reduce size by 25%. Require extra confluence. Good for OB retests at clear levels.

LONDON.notes: Highest priority session. London open kill zone (07-09 UTC) = primary entry window.

NEW_YORK.notes: NY open kill zone (12-14 UTC). Silver Bullet setup (09:30-11:00 NY time) is prime.

NY_CLOSE.notes: Low activity. Only high confidence setups. Prefer managing existing trades.

scale_in_rules.description: Scale into winning trades when push momentum is confirmed
trigger_conditions: Trade is in profit by at least 1.0R
Initial SL already moved to break-even
Push phase confirmed on M15 (bodies growing in direction of trade)
No opposing BOS on H1 — structure intact
Original confluence factors still valid (OB not mitigated, bias unchanged)
scale_in_rules: Add 50% of original position size when 1R profit reached and push confirmed
Scale-in SL = same as current trailing SL (already at BE or better)
Scale-in TP = 1.5x original TP3 level (let the runner run)
Maximum 1 scale-in per trade — no pyramiding beyond 2 units
If original trade hits TP1 (50% closed) THEN push confirmed: scale-in with remaining runner
scale_in_rules.notes: Scale-in is only executed when momentum is clearly confirmed. Exhaustion phase = close partial, do NOT add.

opposing_liquidity_rules._comment: v2.2: TP targets anchored to OPPOSING liquidity — backtest-hardened for XAUUSD max profit
opposing_liquidity_rules.description: Stop losses are placed beyond inducing liquidity. Take profits are placed at opposing liquidity pools. This is the core ICT principle: buy where they sell, sell where they buy.
long_tp_targets: TP1 (50%): Next H4 bearish OB or prior equal highs / resistance cluster
TP2 (30%): Prior daily high (PDH) or significant H4 structural high
TP3 (20% runner): Equal highs above current structure = institutional liquidity target
Extended: Weekly high if weekly structure supports continuation
short_tp_targets: TP1 (50%): Next H4 bullish OB or prior equal lows / support cluster
TP2 (30%): Prior daily low (PDL) or significant H4 structural low
TP3 (20% runner): Equal lows below current structure = institutional liquidity target
Extended: Weekly low if weekly structure supports continuation

xauusd_specific.round_numbers_as_liquidity: Every $50 increment (2350, 2400, 2450...) is a magnet. Place TP just before round number to avoid being front-run
xauusd_specific.weekend_gap_fill: Price often fills weekend gap by Tuesday. If gap remains unfilled and HTF supports, target gap level as extended TP
xauusd_specific.ny_session_close: If TP is near and NY close approaching (within 2h), tighten TP to ensure capture. Liquidity dries post-16:00 UTC
xauusd_specific.notes: XAUUSD opposing liquidity = equal highs/lows, round numbers, prior session extremes, weekly open

sl_placement_rules: BUY SL: 1.2x ATR below entry OR below lowest M15 candle body that formed OB (whichever is lower)
SELL SL: 1.2x ATR above entry OR above highest M15 candle body that formed OB (whichever is higher)
Never place SL inside a liquidity pool (equal highs/lows within 3x spread)
SL MUST be beyond inducing liquidity — the level that was swept to induce your entry

exit_rules.notes: Move SL to breakeven after TP1 hit. Always leave runner (20%) for extended moves. Close runner if opposing BOS prints on H1.

smart_trail._comment: V2 Adaptive Multi-Layer Trailing Stop — crypto-style profit protection

early_protection.at_0.5R: move SL to entry + 1 pip (guarantee non-loss)
early_protection.at_1.5R: lock +1.0R minimum — never give back more than 50% of gains

xauusd_adjustments.notes: Gold wider trails, same profit lock logic

smart_trail.notes: V2.1 TUNED: wider base trail (1.5x), reduced spread_atr_frac (0.15), tight_equity_threshold 5.0, tighter compress 0.8, fixed spread=price via tick_size, added peak_r historical tracking, corrected SELL peak-SL direction, symbol-aware config selector

scale_up_on_win_streak.notes: Risk increases 0.25% after 3 wins, another 0.25% after 5 wins. Resets on any loss.

limit_orders.notes: Bot places LIMIT orders at OTE entry points. If price blows past limit by 10 pips, cancel. If price already past entry on signal, fallback to MARKET.

confidence_thresholds.notes: Adaptive memory engine adjusts these per setup type based on live win rate data

sweep_gate_rules._comment: v2.1: FVG/CHoCH entries now require prior sweep confirmation
sweep_gate_rules.description: ICT core principle: stop hunt precedes every valid entry. Without a sweep, imbalance entries are premature.

fvg_without_sweep.exception: CISD or Inverted FVG detected restores threshold to 55-58

chop_filter.condition: total_range < 2.5x avg_bar_range over last 20 H1 bars
chop_filter.action: Skip FVG/CHoCH entries — only sweep entries allowed in consolidation

new_entry_models._comment: v2.1: Added Inverted FVG (CISD) and Change in State of Delivery

inverted_fvg.description: Price closes aggressively THROUGH an opposing FVG, confirming directional intent
inverted_fvg.buy_trigger: Current bar closes above a prior bearish FVG (CISD BUY)
inverted_fvg.sell_trigger: Current bar closes below a prior bullish FVG (CISD SELL)
inverted_fvg.notes: Acts as partial sweep confirmation when no external liquidity has been swept

cisd.description: Change in State of Delivery: 3-bar same-direction run engulfed by opposing candle (50%+ body)
cisd.buy_trigger: 3 consecutive bearish bars engulfed by 1 strong bullish bar
cisd.sell_trigger: 3 consecutive bullish bars engulfed by 1 strong bearish bar
cisd.notes: Signals institutional order flow shift — valid CISD at key level = high-probability entry

ai_learning_rules.description: How the AI adapts its rules based on live performance

adjustment_logic.win_rate_above_70pct: Add +10 confidence bonus to this setup type permanently

ai_learning_rules.notes: Every trade is logged with full context. System learns which confluence factors predict winners.

XAUUSD.notes: Gold -- primary instrument. Asia valid with clear OB. 6mo backtest: +2045%, 37% WR, 48% max DD. Key: TP to opposing liquidity, trail at 2-3.5x ATR, lock profits at +0.5R.

NAS100.notes: NAS100 NY kill zone only — high volatility requires stricter rules

GBPJPY.notes: Wide spreads + high volatility — require extra confluence

XAGUSD.notes: Silver -- thin and prone to false sweeps; require highest bar

equity_gate.message: Silver locked until account reaches $300 equity. Start with EURUSD/GBPUSD first.

EURUSD.notes: Low setup frequency — only high-confluence setups

dual_tf.notes: H4=macro bias, H1=HTF structure, M5=LTF trigger. OTE 50pct OB body entry. Kill zone +0.10. CISD +0.15. Sweep gate on FVG fills.

scaling.notes: ADD pyramids with BOS confluence; REDUCE trims on LTF reversal at +2R.

signals._comment: Output paths for signals.json and pine overlay. mirror_mt5_common_path writes a second copy for MT5 OmniSignalOverlay.

leverage_compounding._comment: Win-streak risk multipliers. Enable only after 30+ paper-forward days with positive expectancy.

recovery_protocol._comment: Auto-resume trading after a drawdown halt.

reconnect_policy._comment: MT5 data staleness limits and retry behaviour.

continuation._comment: Stage-2 AMD: re-accumulation → re-manipulation → expanded distribution toward HTF liquidity
continuation.notes: After Stage-1 distribution, watches for a tight consolidation followed by a counter-trend sweep that fails. TPs anchor to nearest → PDL/PDH → PWL/PWH liquidity pools. Falls back to range projection if HTF pools are sparse.

amd.notes: AMD scan runs each cycle on M15 bars. DISTRIBUTION phase adds entry/SL/TP to signal metadata. Confidence bonus applied when AMD aligns with dual-TF direction. Stage-2 (continuation) automatically detected when re-accumulation + re-manipulation form after the first leg.

distribution_intervals._comment: Round-number TP snapping grid per instrument. 0 = disabled.
